note: Frontier release radar: expected upcoming models + market-implied odds, adversarially verified against real markets/announcements.

items.basis: Missed a third launch deadline after a ground-up retrain; reports say coding/reasoning below bar. Google is now weighing a stopgap release rather than the full Pro.

Polymarket's 'GPT-6 released by' market runs ~90% by Dec 31 and ~75% by Sep 30; OpenAI's line still flows through the GPT-5.6 family (Sol/Terra/Luna public Jul 9), keeping the numbered flagship a second-half story.
Anthropic's ~6-week Opus cadence (4.6 Feb, 4.7 Apr, 4.8 May) points to a next Opus; Polymarket prices a next Claude Opus at ~96% by Oct 31, though the exact version is unannounced.

xAI shipped Grok 4.5 on Jul 16; Manifold now prices Grok 5 at just ~16% before Sep (8% before Aug). The 6T V9-foundation model is reportedly still training on Colossus 2, with public access likely slipping to Q3+.
V4-Pro/Flash shipped Apr 24 as previews; a stable GA is pending, with a reported late-July developer deadline now near.
